verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a 'conversion-optimized' flow for capturing government-issued photo IDs. Community users report it does image analysis in the browser, hands off from desktop to phone for capture, and that users 'rarely get stuck', which supports guided web capture. Native mobile SDKs and the specific coaching cues are not evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of native iOS SDK, native Android SDK, documented glare/blur/edge-detection coaching, first-try capture success metrics.
